title: "Manager" Achievement Broken Due to Projects Classic Deprecation
body:
The "Manager" achievement (from plugin_achievements) is failing because it uses the deprecated Projects (classic) API: [sunset on May 23, 2024](https://github.blog/changelog/2024-05-23-sunset-notice-projects-classic/).

**Error observed:**

```
errors: [
  {
    'NOT_FOUND',
    [ 'user', 'projects' ],
    [ { line: 50, column: 5 } ],
    'Projects (classic) is being deprecated in favor of the new Projects experience, see: [https://github.blog/changelog/2024-05-23-sunset-notice-projects-classic/.](https://github.blog/changelog/2024-05-23-sunset-notice-projects-classic/)'
]
```

**Reproduction steps:**

1. Use this workflow:
```yml
- uses: lowlighter/metrics@latest
  with:
    plugin_achievements: yes
```
2. Have at least one Project V2 in your account.
3. Run the action.

**Proposed solution:**

Code Change in [plugins/achievements/list/users.mjs](https://github.com/lowlighter/metrics/blob/master/source/plugins/achievements/list/users.mjs) `Manager block`

**Additional Context:**

Impact: Affects all users with Projects V2 who enable plugin_achievements

Documentation:
- [Project GraphQL Schema](https://docs.github.com/en/graphql/reference/objects#project)
- [Projects V2 GraphQL Schema](https://docs.github.com/en/graphql/reference/objects#projectv2)

_Originally posted by @TonySatrem in https://github.com/lowlighter/metrics/discussions/1705_

title: Umbrella issue for metrics v4
body:
Followup of:
- #1542

Below is the list of identified missing features or bugs that is related to metrics v4
Items that are already linked to an issue are referenced directly in the code at the revelant places

- **Engine**
  - Support conditionals execution (c.f. API quotas and image hash comparison)
    - Possibly support loops ?  
- **Utils**
  - Support advanced filtering options for `matchPatterns()` (such as stars, followers, etc.)
  - Implement a language guesser that doesn't rely directly on the filesystem and that is deno compliant
  - Change `logs: none` to `logs: false` 
  - Support world graphs (c.f. stargazers plugin)
  - Support recording web pages as gifs (c.f. skyline plugin)
- **Features**
  - #1574   
- **Web UI** 
  - #1572
  - #1576
  - Create additional presets directly from the web UI 
    - Offer to publish users presets and reuse them kind like a marketplace ?
  - CSS styling (need some rework because they were made on a yellowed-screen which fucked up the colors)
  - Support drag and drop to change orders of plugins and processors
  - Add a button to clone plugins/processors
  - Support editing the raw YAML snippet and sync them back to the HTML inputs
- **Documentation**
  - Contribution guidelines
  - Readme
  - End-user documentation
  - Developer documentation 
- **Testing**
  - Parallel testing to enable in `deno.jsonc`
  - Enable `Browser` tests again (issue with some promise resolution)
  - #1571
  - #1575 
- **Deployments**
  - Support vercel deno 
  - Add deploy helper to the cli
  - Rework CI pipeline

I think it would be useful to add support for alternative services, especially OpenStreetMap Nominatim which has lots of [providers](https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Nominatim#Alternatives/Third-party_providers) some with reasonable free daily limits, including [MapQuest](https://developer.mapquest.com/documentation/open/nominatim-search/) which has a free limit of [15,000 per month](https://developer.mapquest.com/plans). The base url endpoint could be a setting so that the user can choose which provider works best for them. Most [JS Nominatim clients](https://www.npmjs.com/search?q=nominatim) support this.

title: feat(app/metrics): grouped users metrics support
body:
### Discussed in https://github.com/lowlighter/metrics/discussions/1056

Change typing of `user`/`token` to allow multiple values:
```yml
user: foo, bar
token: |
  {
    "foo": ${{ secrets.FOO_TOKEN }},
    "bar": ${{ secrets.BAR_TOKEN }}
  }
```

For action:
- Try to test out multiple user data fetching and use adequate merging strategy (probably best to test with a subset of plugins first).
- Instantiate and use octokit with correct token to fetch out private data if asked by user.

For web instances:
- Make a "round-robin" balancing over tokens to support more than 5000 requests
